subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should maintainers require live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof for this candidate, provide that proof themselves, or explicitly waive the credential gap for the chosen duplicate PR?
rationale: The contributor disclosed that they do not have a Z.AI Coding Plan key, but external PRs still need real behavior proof unless maintainers intentionally accept or override that gap.

options.title: Require Or Provide Live Proof
options.body: Add redacted live endpoint-detection output, logs, or terminal proof for a Coding Plan key before merging the chosen candidate PR.

options.title: Waive The Credential Gap
options.body: Explicitly accept the source/test evidence for this narrow header fix and apply a maintainer proof override before merge.

options.title: Choose Another Candidate
options.body: Select a stronger duplicate PR as the canonical landing path and leave this PR pending or close it after that fix merges.

recommendation.title: Require Or Provide Live Proof
recommendation.body: Add redacted live endpoint-detection output, logs, or terminal proof for a Coding Plan key before merging the chosen candidate PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Z.AI endpoint-detection behavior and is the clearest historical owner for deciding whether the live-credential proof gap can be waived.
